component: Account Hub manual OAuth selection and validation

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing leaves OAuth available and selected for unknown hosts, shows independent incoming/outgoing warnings, and rejects Test Configuration until provider details are known or another auth method is chosen. Both validate and the completed event guard the action, while Advanced configuration stays available. The caller supplies alert-role slot markup and a support-link handler. Tests check attributes, state and events, not native announcements, external routing or successful authentication. Provider lookup omits username, and the original production template namespace is not covered by the standalone HTML fixture; later explicit namespace markup is separate.
title: The manual OAuth form preserves selection while blocking unsupported configuration tests
